tools.name: careclinic_capabilities
tools.description: Shows the CareClinic data and actions available in this release.

tools.name: careclinic_account
tools.description: Returns the connected CareClinic account’s plan and basic-versus-full insight entitlement.

tools.name: careclinic_today_schedule
tools.description: Returns today’s owned medication and supplement occurrences with time, dose, reminder identity, and status.

tools.name: careclinic_search_catalog
tools.description: Finds an owned medication, symptom or sleep care plan before preparing a log. Never invent an item ID.

tools.name: careclinic_recent_wellness
tools.description: Returns minimized symptom, mood, medication and sleep activity. Notes and internal record IDs are excluded.

tools.name: careclinic_get_insights
tools.description: Creates deterministic observational summaries. Free accounts receive basic counts; detailed reports and chart values are returned only for Premium accounts.

tools.name: careclinic_preview_log
tools.description: Validates an exact owned symptom, mood or sleep entry and creates a short-lived confirmation preview. It never writes data. Scheduled medication and supplement taken/skipped events are enabled.

tools.name: careclinic_commit_log
tools.description: App-only write used by the CareClinic confirmation card. It writes only the exact entry represented by a valid signed preview after explicit confirmation. Replaying the same preview returns the original receipt instead of creating a duplicate.
